test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 22 Nov, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the following series were to be continued?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d20d10ba88a0dc6602752463052e9216e259e62420efd803d2971e96c9e006ca.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) First box series →

The first column elements shift clockwise in the downward direction.

The last two elements of the 2nd row from the left interchange positions.

The rest of the element is shift anticlockwise.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/797cf64f02ce962b56d36d47f88144effb6afe0679cccb6aa0ba130a4e7c4565.png] 

2) Second box series → 

The elements at the corner of the 2nd row interchange positions.

The rest of elements of the 2nd row interchange positions.

The elements at the corner interchange positions diagonally.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4796ae81dee9394bac62588d5055deb67a3f543f398b7a20dc9fcbf67df86c76.png] 

Thus, the final series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/63c297636dcd51153672c36674659574fbb3a315dbddc890fa3e2220e1938bbd.png] 

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
